_account_legend: Each account is tagged (a) retirement vs non-retirement and (b) liquid (cash/investments) vs illiquid (home equity). These tags power the breakdown views. growth_rate is the annual nominal rate used in forward projections. home_equity is net of the mortgage so it is already equity, not gross value.
_liability_legend: Liabilities reduce net worth. mortgage_balance is the outstanding principal. Liquid (ex-housing) net worth excludes home_equity (asset) and mortgage_balance (liability).

projections._contributions_legend: Monthly contribution added to each account in projections. 2083/mo 401k ≈ 25k/yr pre-tax; 583/mo ≈ max Roth IRA. Adjust to your real plan.
projections._projections_legend: Forward projection compounds each account at its growth_rate with monthly contributions. A Monte Carlo simulation over volatility_annual_pct produces the p10/p50/p90 band. volatile buckets: non_retirement_liquid shows taxable investing only (cash/savings grow at ~0).

password._legend: Client-side gate: only a SHA-256 hash of the password is embedded in the built HTML. This blocks casual readers/view-source snoops but is NOT real security (the gate lives in JS and can be bypassed). Set a real password before deploying publicly.
